name: curl
description: Run curl against an Access-protected application with its JWT injected by cloudflared.

options.name: allow-request
options.description: Continue the request when no Access token is available

name: login
description: Authenticate with an Access application and store its JWT through cloudflared.

options.name: auto-close
options.description: automatically close the auth interstitial after action

options.name: no-verbose
options.description: print only the jwt to stdout

options.name: quiet
options.description: do not print the jwt to the command line

name: ssh-config
description: Print an example SSH configuration for an Access application.

options.name: hostname
options.description: specify the hostname of your application.

options.name: short-lived-cert
options.description: specify if you wish to generate short lived certs.

name: ssh-gen
description: Generate a short-lived certificate for an Access SSH application.

options.name: hostname
options.description: specify the hostname of your application.

name: tcp
description: Proxy a TCP connection through Access. The command is also available as ssh, rdp, and smb.

options.name: hostname
options.description: specify the hostname of your application.

options.name: destination
options.description: specify the destination address of your SSH server.

options.name: url
options.description: specify the host:port to forward data to Cloudflare edge.

options.name: header
options.description: specify additional headers you wish to send.

options.name: service-token-id
options.description: specify an Access service token ID you wish to use.

options.name: service-token-secret
options.description: specify an Access service token secret you wish to use.

options.name: log-level
options.description: Application logging level {debug, info, warn, error, fatal}.

options.name: log-directory
options.description: Save application log to this directory for reporting issues.

options.name: logfile
options.description: Save application log to this file for reporting issues.

name: token
description: Print a JWT for authenticating with an Access application.
